sourcePolicy: Three genuine Indonesian Android 1.0.16 (19) captures with official adb in a fresh isolated API 35 emulator, continuing the previously authorized method. Existing test APK installed; visible Bahasa Indonesia setting selected. No app source edits or rebuild. Four compositions; rewards and notes reuse the actual candidate board. Only OS bars cropped, full UI uniformly scaled, captions outside the UI. No UI redrawing or AI bitmap assets.
